mapper.select: SELECT pro.PICATEGORY as name, pro.SUMPRICE AS value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY pro.SUMPRICE desc) AS top from ( SELECT pf.PSTARTDATE,pf.PENDDATE,pi.PICATEGORY, SUM(pi.PISUMPRICE) AS SUMPRICE FROM PRODUCTFORM pf , PRODUCTITEM pi WHERE pf.PFNUM = pi.PFNUM GROUP BY pf.PSTARTDATE, pf.PENDDATE, pi.PICATEGORY ) pro WHERE #{rmonth} BETWEEN TO_CHAR(pro.PSTARTDATE, 'YYYY-MM') AND TO_CHAR(pro.PENDDATE, 'YYYY-MM')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO REVENUE ( RMONTH, RTOTALQTY, RTOTALSALES, RTOTALCOST, RTOTALMARGIN, PFNUM) VALUES ( TO_DATE(#{rmonth}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), #{rtotalqty}, #{rtotalsales}, #{rtotalcost}, #{rtotalmargin}, #{pfnum} )
mapper.select: select pro.PIPRICE AS PRICE, pro.PIAMOUNT AS RTOTALQTY, pro.PISUMPRICE AS RTOTALSALES, pro.PIUNITCOST AS RTOTALCOST, pro.pfnum AS PFNUM, pro.PICATEGORY AS CATEGORY FROM ( SELECT pf.PSTARTDATE,pf.PENDDATE,pf.PFNUM, pi.PINAME,pi.PIPRICE,pi.PIAMOUNT,pi.PISUMPRICE,pi.PIUNITCOST,pi.PICATEGORY FROM PRODUCTFORM pf , PRODUCTITEM pi WHERE pf.PFNUM = pi.PFNUM ) pro WHERE #{rmonth} BETWEEN TO_CHAR(pro.PSTARTDATE, 'YYYY-MM') AND TO_CHAR(pro.PENDDATE, 'YYYY-MM')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM REVENUE WHERE TO_CHAR(RMONTH, 'YYYY-MM') = #{rmonth}
